main.summary: Describes one storage block used to assemble a published stream from a logical transfer range.

property.name: DestinationOffset
property.summary: Destination stream offset at which the block is assembled.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Number of bytes represented by the block.

property.name: LogicalSegmentIndex
property.summary: Zero-based index of the logical transfer segment containing the block.

property.name: LogicalRange
property.summary: Logical transfer range containing the block.

property.name: Source
property.summary: Staged tenant-storage blob containing the source bytes.

property.name: SourceOffset
property.summary: Offset within the source blob at which the block begins.
